comments.content: is_always_monotonic_chain uses a default-constructed Field{} for both low and high bounds when calling getMonotonicityForRange(*types.front(), field, field). For many types/functions the monotonicity query is value-dependent or requires a valid Field, so using an empty Field can give false positives/negatives or even assert. The check should be performed in a value-independent way or with proper representative bounds for the key type, and the argument type used should be the actual key type rather than unconditionally types.front().
